title: Dev Agency Website
description: Dark-themed freelance dev agency landing page — expertise, team, CTA, and featured work carousel with admin CMS.

blocks.text: The dev-agency template is a lean studio site: hero, expertise cards, team grid, contact CTA, and an auto-scrolling featured-work carousel. Content is editable from /admin (expertise, team, portfolio rows) with seed defaults until you add database rows. Core modules enquiry-modal and seo are included; gallery, reviews, blog-compose, and footer module are not — add them later with tempjs add-module if needed.

items: Expertise — skill cards (title, description, icon) via admin or defaults
Team — member cards with roles and avatar colors
Contact CTA — gradient headline + enquiry button
Featured work — continuous carousel with client URL, category, review
Header & footer — agency nav links and contact columns from SITE.agency

blocks.text: This template ships with enquiry-modal and seo only. Gallery, reviews, blog-compose, footer, and legal-pages are not installed by default — add them later with tempjs add-module (client project) or pnpm template:add-module dev-agency … (monorepo).
Dev Agency defaults to a dark landing palette. Install theme-modes to let visitors switch to a light palette, edit both palettes in admin Theme & Colors, and mount ThemeModeToggle in the navbar.

blocks.code:
tempjs add-module theme-modes
# Monorepo:
pnpm template:add-module dev-agency theme-modes

blocks.text: See Developers → Light & dark themes for full install steps and ThemeModeToggle wiring.

Dev Agency is a good lean base if you want studio landing sections first and a technical blog later. Install blog-compose with the +sidebar suffix to get /blog routes, an admin compose editor, and a docs-style left sidebar (article list + on-page H2 table of contents). The +sidebar suffix sets SITE.features.blogSidebar — see Compose blog module for block types and JSON shape.

blocks.title: Full module guide
blocks.text: Developers → Blog → Compose module (/developers/blog-compose) — live articles, playground, and Compose document reference.

blocks.code:
tempjs dev-agency config
# from generated project root:
tempjs add-module blog-compose+sidebar
pnpm prisma db push
pnpm dev

blocks.text: add-module copies blog-compose files, merges BlogPost into Prisma, enables SITE.features.blogCompose and blogSidebar, and adds a Blog articles tab on /admin. It does not edit app/HomePage.tsx — add a homepage teaser and nav link yourself when you want blog on the landing page:

blocks.code:
pnpm template:add-module dev-agency blog-compose+sidebar
pnpm prisma db push
pnpm dev:dev-agency

blocks.text: Same module install as client projects; use this when developing the template in the monorepo without generating a separate client copy.
